errors.evidence: The x-axis tick labels go up to 10³, and the final data points are plotted before the midpoint to 10⁴. Describing the range as extending to approximately 10⁴ is an overstatement.
The starting value for the "FT" method is closer to 31.5% on the y-axis, not 32%.
For the “MEMIT” method, the ACC value at a Co-occurrence Number of 10² is approximately 46%, not 43.5%. The value at 10¹ is approximately 43%.
This phrase compares the trend of the ROME line with the other lines, which constitutes an interpretation and comparison that the prompt explicitly forbids.
The legend is positioned at the top of the chart area, organized into two columns that span from the left side toward the center, not just in the top-left corner.
